summary_en: Response of the Congregation to a dubium (no protocol or date printed): only one heavenly patron may be constituted, celebrated as a rule at the rank of feast (the Apostolic See may grant the rank of solemnity); two or more saints may be chosen together only if they are inscribed in the calendar under one celebration; a secondary patron is added only by rare indult and is celebrated at the rank of memorial; only saints, not blesseds, may be patrons without special indult.
excerpt: An liceat duos vel plures Sanctos in Patronos caelestes constituere vel alium, tamquam secundarium addere? R. Negative ad utrumque. ... Qui Patronus gradu festi de more est celebrandus, etiamsi, rationibus pastoralibus suadentibus, Apostolica Sedes gradum sollemnitatis concedere potest. ... Quo in casu Patronus secundarius gradu memoriae celebratur.

summary_en: In the Calendarium Romanum Generale printed in the 2008 reimpressio emendata of the Missale Romanum (editio typica tertia), at Missal p. 112 the word 'martyris' is removed from the entry of day 29. The month is not printed; p. 112 falls between January (p. 105) and September (p. 113), so this is most probably 29 August, the Passion of St John the Baptist. No separate decree, protocol or date is printed for this change.
excerpt: Calendarium Romanum Generale / p. 112: Ad diem 29: tollitur « martyris ».

summary_en: The 2008 reimpressio emendata of the Missale Romanum inserts St Pius of Pietrelcina, priest, into the Calendarium Romanum Generale on 23 September as a memorial, with a proper collect in the Supplementum (p. 1276); this implements the earlier decree of insertion (2002), which is not reprinted here, so no protocol or date is attached.
excerpt: p. 113: Ad diem 23: additur: « S. Pii de Pietrelcina, presbyteri – Memoria ».

summary_en: The 2008 reimpressio emendata of the Missale Romanum inserts St Juan Diego Cuauhtlatoatzin into the Calendarium Romanum Generale on 9 December, with a proper collect in the Supplementum (p. 1276); this implements the earlier decree of insertion (2002), which is not reprinted here, so no protocol or date is attached. The rank is not printed in the calendar line, so grade is left null.
excerpt: p. 116: Ad diem 9: additur: « S. Ioannis Didaci Cuauhtlatoatzin ».

summary_en: The 2008 reimpressio emendata of the Missale Romanum inserts the Blessed Virgin Mary of Guadalupe into the Calendarium Romanum Generale on 12 December, with a proper collect in the Supplementum (p. 1277); this implements the earlier decree of insertion (2002), which is not reprinted here, so no protocol or date is attached. The rank is not printed in the calendar line, so grade is left null.
excerpt: p. 116: Ad diem12: additur: « B. Mariae Virginis de Guadalupe ».

summary_en: In the Proprium de Sanctis of the 2008 reimpressio emendata of the Missale Romanum, at Missal p. 869 the word 'religiosae' is added after the title 'S. Elisabeth Hungariae' (17 November), aligning the Missal formulary title with the Calendarium Romanum Generale, which already reads 'religiosae'. No separate decree, protocol or date is printed.
excerpt: p. 869: Ad diem 17 novembris post titulum « S. Elisabeth Hungariae », additur « religiosae ».
